chunks.why: Ulysses captive with Calypso weeping for home; suitors overrun palace, consume his goods.
Suitors refuse to leave; Telemachus sails to Pylos; Ulysses still lost, no news.
Nestor, then Menelaus host Telemachus; Ulysses absent, presumed still trapped.
Proteus confirms Ulysses held by Calypso weeping; gods order release; Ulysses builds raft.
Neptune wrecks raft; Ulysses nearly drowns, staggers ashore naked, sleeps in leaves.
Alcinous and Areta welcome him warmly, promise safe conduct home, offer princess.
Phaeacian gifts and games; begins tale — Ismarus battle, Lotus-eaters, Cyclops traps him.
Cyclops eats men; escape but Neptune cursed; Aeolus fails; Laestrygonians destroy eleven ships; Circe swines crew.
Year with Circe eases men; descends to Hades; Tiresias promises hard return; sees dead mother, murdered Agamemnon.
Sirens, Scylla eats six; crew slays Sun's cattle; ship destroyed; all crew drowned; alone to Calypso.
Phaeacians deliver Ulysses with treasure to Ithaca; Athena disguises him; loyal Eumaeus receives him kindly.
Eumaeus hospitably feasts the disguised Ulysses; Telemachus sails safely homeward from Sparta.
Telemachus reaches Eumaeus; Ulysses reveals himself to his son; father and son plan the vengeance.
Ulysses enters own palace disguised, insulted by Melanthius and Antinous; dying dog Argus recognizes him.
Ulysses defeats beggar Irus in a fight; endures Eurymachus's hurled stool while quietly planning slaughter.
Long talk with Penelope; nurse Euryclea recognizes the scar; Penelope resolves on the bow contest.
Ulysses reveals himself to loyal Eumaeus and Philoetius; suitors fail to string bow; he takes it.
Bends the bow, shoots the rings; slaughters every suitor in the hall; hangs faithless maids; his kingdom regained.
Penelope tests him with the bed's secret; joyful reunion in their marriage bed; recounts his wanderings safe home.
Reunited with father Laertes; townsfolk's uprising quelled by Athena; peace sworn, Ulysses king again.
